programs.desc: The Mob Museum makes Wayde and Brett an offer they can't refuse! They want a tank with replica sunken rumrunner for their prohibition exhibit and speakeasy in downtown Las Vegas.

programs.title: Wheeler Dealers
programs.desc: Mike enlists Edd's help to make this '70s hatchback cool again. But with a limited budget and some wacky ideas, are they en route for a profit?

programs.title: Texas Metal
programs.desc: Bill Carlton must find the balance between handmade metal work and the iconic designs of two Ford trucks, one from 1931 and another from 1949.

programs.title: Bitchin' Rides: Road To The Ridler
programs.desc: Fabrication begins in earnest. The team realizes the sheer difficulty of hand-crafting every panel from aluminium, especially trying to replicate Dave's complex sketches.

programs.title: Counting Cars
programs.desc: Danny is so proud of the van he restored as a gift for his bandmate John Zito, that he decides to give his own classic van a make-over. Will he able to out do himself? Later, Danny and Kevin pullover an NBA star.

programs.title: Counting Cars
programs.desc: Danny sees something in his shop that makes him very uncomfortable, emptiness. So he sends the entire crew to the streets to find him cars, and fast. Danny wishes them well but promises, he will return with the biggest catch of the day.

programs.title: Iron Resurrection
programs.desc: An iconic car is checked off their bucket list when they get their hands on a '70 Chevelle. To make it into a drag car, they fit a monster motor, big tires, tricked out frame and a roll cage, along with a last minute chopped roof line.
